ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE 3D rendering engine, the core library (OgreMain)
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The core of OGRE 14.6.3 (the classic Ogre 1.x line, not Ogre-Next): scene management, resources, scripts, materials, compositors, animation, image and mesh codecs and ZIP archives. The configuration headers which the upstream CMake build generates are checked in under dependencies/Ogre/include. It is built as C++14, which is what OGRE requires.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO codec plugin for Sun/NeXT .au audio
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads and writes .au / .snd files: 8, 16, 24 and 32 bit linear, 32 and 64 bit float, mu-law and A-law. Written in C against the gucefAUDIO codec plugin C interface, it also serves as the reference for that interface.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO codec plugin for FLAC audio
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads and writes FLAC files. Decoding is done by dr_flac, sample exact seeking included, with 16 bit samples for up to 16 bits per sample and left justified 32 bit samples for more, so lossless audio stays exact. Writing is done by a small encoder in the plugin (fixed predictors with Rice coding, STREAMINFO with MD5). Written in C against the gucefAUDIO codec plugin C interface.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO codec plugin for MP3 audio
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads MP3 files (MPEG 1, 2 and 2.5 layer III). Decoding is done by dr_mp3, sample exact seeking included, with an optional seek table made when the file is opened, and gapless playback when the file has a LAME tag. Tags are the ID3v2 text frames and the ID3v1 fields. Decoding only. Written in C against the gucefAUDIO codec plugin C interface.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO codec plugin for Ogg Vorbis and Ogg Opus audio
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads and writes Ogg Vorbis and Ogg Opus files under the types ogg, oga and opus; the first packet of the file decides which codec it is. Decoding is done by vorbisfile and opusfile, sample exact seeking included, with the surround channels in WAVE order. Writing is done by libvorbisenc and by libopus with a small Ogg Opus writer on libogg. The Opus part is only built where the opus module is. Written in C against the gucefAUDIO codec plugin C interface.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO voice codec plugin for Opus
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Registers the voice codec "opus" (libopus) with the gucefAUDIO voice codec registry: encoders and decoders of mono voice frames with the low delay profile (CELT, frames of 2.5 to 20 ms) and the robust profile (SILK with forward error correction, frames of 20 ms), concealment of lost frames, and recovery of a lost frame from the next one. The encoders and decoders run on the audio threads: they allocate no memory, take no lock and do no IO. A C++ link-back plugin, as the audio drivers are.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefMULTIPLAY match provider plugin that carries matches between players as e-mail
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The match provider mail: matches between participants who each have an ordinary mailbox, without a server of ours. Every participant signs what they send, turns travel as mail with an attachment or as encoded text in the body, are received over IMAP (IDLE or polling) or POP3 and are applied only after the signatures, the chain of revisions and the game's own replay check agree.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Shared owner of the Epic Online Services platform for the EOS plugins
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Makes the EOS platform once for the auth, lobby and P2P plugins (reference counted), ticks it from the pulse generator of the application, keeps who is logged in, and routes the packets and connections of the EOS P2P interface to named sockets. Everything of the SDK goes through function tables, so the library builds and tests without the SDK.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Shared owner of the connection to the Wayland compositor for the Wayland window and input plugins
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Makes the one connection of the process to the compositor, binds the globals the plugins use (compositor, xdg-shell, seat, monitors, scale and cursor extensions), pumps it from the pulse generator of the application without blocking, hands the pointer and keyboard events of the seat to listeners and keeps the pointer image. The system libraries are loaded when asked for and everything of the protocol goes through function tables, so the library builds without the Wayland development packages and tests with a fake compositor.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefCORE table codec plugin for Apache Parquet files
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads and writes parquet files as data tables: flat schemas, PLAIN and dictionary encodings, row groups, statistics and in place pages, with its own Thrift compact protocol. Compression goes through the codec registry.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Generic GUCEF VFS plugin for CD images described by a CUE sheet (BIN/CUE)
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Mounts a .cue sheet with its BIN file(s): the file system of the first data track (read through the iso9660 archive type of vfspluginISO9660) and the audio tracks as CDDA/TRACKnn.WAV. Raw 2352 byte and cooked 2048 byte sectors, MODE1 and MODE2. Own implementation.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Generic GUCEF VFS plugin for ISO 9660 disc images
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Own implementation with random access. Supports Joliet and Rock Ridge names.

ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Decodes Smacker (.smk) videos: the palette pictures and the audio tracks, compressed or plain. Written in C against the gucefVIDEO codec plugin C interface from the published format description; links nothing from GUCEF.
